# ScriptNbtCompound

*Common*

NBT compound: named values of the Minecraft data format, from `scram.compound()` or the data of items, entities and blocks.

## Methods

### getMinecraftNbtCompound {#getminecraftnbtcompound}

::: member

**Returns** `NbtCompound` — the Minecraft compound this wrapper changes, for Java code

:::

### isCompound {#iscompound}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — true

:::

### isList {#islist}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — false: a compound is not a list

:::

### stringify {#stringify}

::: member

**Returns** [`String`](/scripting/js/String) — the value as SNBT text, like `{Health:20.0f,Tags:["boss"]}`, which `scram.compound` reads back

:::

### isEmpty {#isempty}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether it holds no values

:::

### size {#size}

::: member

**Returns** [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) — number of keys

:::

### copy {#copy}

::: member

**Returns** [`Nbt`](/scripting/common/nbt/Nbt) — deep copy; changing it does not change this one

:::

### combine {#combine}

::: member

Copies all keys of another compound into this one, replacing values with the same keys.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `nbt` | [`Nbt`](/scripting/common/nbt/Nbt) | compound to copy from; other values are ignored |

:::

### isSame {#issame}

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `nbt` | [`Nbt`](/scripting/common/nbt/Nbt) | other NBT value, or null |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether both hold equal values of the same kind

:::

### has {#has}

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | value name |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the compound has a value under the key

:::

### remove {#remove}

::: member

Removes the value under a key.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | value name; a missing key does nothing |

:::

### keys {#keys}

::: member

**Returns** `Set<String>` — the keys of the compound; it changes with the compound

:::

### getCompound {#getcompound}

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | value name |

**Returns** [`ScriptNbtCompound`](/scripting/common/nbt/ScriptNbtCompound) — the compound under the key, changes to it change this compound; a new empty compound, not stored here, if the key is missing or holds another type (store it with [`setCompound`](#setcompound))

:::

| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | value name |

**Returns** [`ScriptNbtList`](/scripting/common/nbt/ScriptNbtList) — the list under the key, changes to it change this compound; a new empty list, not stored here, if the key is missing or holds another type (store it with [`setList`](#setlist))

### get {#get}

::: member

Reads a value of any type.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | value name |

**Returns** `Any` — the value under the key: a number, a string, a [`ScriptNbtCompound`](/scripting/common/nbt/ScriptNbtCompound) or a [`ScriptNbtList`](/scripting/common/nbt/ScriptNbtList) (both change this compound); booleans come as the bytes 1 and 0; null if the key is missing or holds an array

:::

### addCompound {#addcompound}

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | value name |

:::

### dumpJSON {#dumpjson}

::: member

```js
c.send(c.getPlayer().getMainItem().getNbt().dumpJSON());
```

**Returns** [`String`](/scripting/js/String) — the compound as pretty-printed JSON: bytes 0 and 1 become booleans, lists and arrays become JSON arrays, and infinite or NaN numbers become null; the NBT number types are lost

:::
